verification.method: Every entry is embedded in play.html. Local app pages open directly; portal titles load from the publisher own build URL; no entry links out.
verification.hoodamath: Every HoodaMath game is played from their own build URL (hoodamath.com/mobile/games/<dir>/game.html), checked for HTTP 200 and for the absence of X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors. Maths categories are skipped; puzzle, logic and board games are kept.
verification.scratch: Every Scratch ID probed against the official Scratch API · official /embed player
verification.crazygames: Titles served from games.crazygames.com are embedded through that file host; publisher builds are embedded from their own domain.
verification.providerNote: pf games load from the publisher's own hosting with no portal shell.
verification.noExternalRouting: Entries that could not run in the page were removed rather than linked out.
